evals.prompt: This session you read README.md, chose to persist a decision list in .session-decisions.md instead of conversation-only, ran just lint, skipped a live subagent harness because the repo already uses evals.json plus pytest contracts, committed, and scoped out a third scoring skill as YAGNI. User: /decisions
evals.expected_output: Chronological D1..Dn grok lines for the real choices only; write .session-decisions.md; no transcript or status table
expectations: Assigns stable D1, D2, ... ids in chronological order
One grok line per decision, enough to understand what was chosen
Omits mechanical steps such as reading files, running tests, and committing
Does not use a Done/Open status table
Writes .session-decisions.md and does not commit it
Points the human to /next-decision for a full review

evals.prompt: Recap the decisions you made this session so I can grok them. Do not wait for a slash command if /decisions applies.
evals.expected_output: Same grok list of session decisions, oldest first
expectations: Lists choices not a play-by-play of the session
